title: Odile and the Cover
author: Paloma Villalobos
blurb: Ulyana Nystrom, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
